verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a Custom Integrations capability for creating and mapping custom resources from tools without a native integration. Raw data from cloud, on-prem, legacy or custom-built systems can be pushed via an API endpoint, and Secureframe then normalizes, maps and tests it. This sits on a documented REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0 reference and a dated versioning policy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom integration, and explicit documentation of the specific endpoints for pushing custom resources or test results (the docs describe Secureframe running the tests on pushed data rather than accepting externally computed results).
